newsitem.title: USA: Med/Waste completes USA Waste unit buy.
newsitem.headline: Med/Waste completes USA Waste unit buy.

text.p: Med/Waste Inc said on Wednesday it had completed its purchase of an incineration facility owned by a unit of USA Waste Services Inc.

The facility is owned by Chambers Medical Technologies of South Carolina Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of USA Waste. Med/Waste acquired the facility for a combination of cash and notes payable over a four-year period.

Med/Waste expects the acquisition to positively impact revenues and earnings beginning in the fourth quarter. But it said that internal costs for the purchase will have a negative effect on earnings in the third quarter of 1996.

The Chambers facility, which will now operate as Safety Disposal System of South Carolina Inc, provides waste management and disposal services for non-hazardous medical and special waste customers, primarily in the eastern United States market.
